Appearance:
 Shri Atul Gupta - Advocate for applicant.
 Shri Samar Ghuraiya - Public Prosecutor for respondent/
 Order

The present sixth application has been filed by the applicant under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 seeking grant of regular bail after dismissal of earlier one on merits vide order dated 12.08.2025 passed in M.Cr.C. No.26987 of 2025 by this Court.

The applicant has been arrested on 02.10.2023 in connection with Crime No.573 of 2023 registered at Police Station Padav District Gwalior (M.P.) for offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(n),
376, 363, 366, 370, 323, 506 of IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act and Section 3, 4, 5, 7 of Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act, 1956.

Having heard learned counsel for the parties and on perusal of the case diary as well as the documents annexed with the application, this Court finds that no fresh or substantial ground has been urged which may warrant reconsideration of the matter.
In view of the above and there being no favourable change in circumstance since dismissal of the previous application, this Court does not find it to be a fit case for grant of bail.
